llm_response.reason: The website uses the name and product images of a well-known Italian footwear brand (Fratelli Rossetti) without any affiliation, as indicated by the unrelated domain name (glorawilson.shop). There is no visible company contact information, physical address, or regulatory information, which violates best practices for legitimate e-commerce sites. Searches for reviews and reputation yield no credible results. These match the scam indicators: spoofing legitimate brands, ambiguous company info, lack of updates or verification, and absence of credible reviews.
